sections.title: Independent Study
sections.description: Students enrolled in a Healthcare Quality & Safety program may receive approval to complete an independent study course in lieu of a required core course or elective when a student places out of a core course and/or there are no existing elective courses at the graduate level that can fulfill the student's goals for their program. Independent study courses can be performed in a broad range of activities and settings, as long as the mission and content of the class are consistent with the overarching goals of the HQS program and similar material is not available as an existing class.
